raw.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer I - Germany/Austria/UK
raw.excerpt: Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence.
raw.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it.

This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation.

You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team.

We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Database platform (approx. 60%)

  • Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths.
  • Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions.
  • Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene.
  • Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path.
  • Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require.
  • Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability.

Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%)

  • Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes.
  • Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them.
  • Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant.

Team, incidents, and collaboration

  • Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence.
  • Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person.
  • Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS

Required — PostgreSQL depth

  • 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning.
  • Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services.
  • Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables.
  • Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies.

Required — Infrastructure and ways of working

  • Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS.
  • Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation).
  • Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists.
  • Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued).
  • Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load.
  • Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows.
  • Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional).

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policyhere.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Regional Director, Commercial Sales - LATAM, you'll lead a team of Commercial Account Executives to grow adoption of GitLab's artificial intelligence (AI)-powered DevSecOps platform, which brings together software development, security, and operations. You'll own software sales, bookings, and revenue across the region, helping new and existing customers increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk.

You’ll also build a foundational operational discipline, including a defined sales cadence, a common methodology (MEDDPICC and Command of the Message) applied consistently across the team, and a partner strategy that multiplies regional coverage.

Reporting to the Area Vice President, LATAM, you'll hire and develop your team, set territory and industry strategies, and align regional sales plans with GitLab's growth goals. In your first year, you'll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening customer relationships across LATAM, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop Commercial Account Executives serving the LATAM market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results.
  • Build territory and industry plans based on market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends, and turn those plans into growth opportunities.
  • Establish that operating rhythm including qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, deal inspection, and forecast accuracy.
  • Own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and regional growth strategies aligned with GitLab's revenue goals.
  • Establish, track, and report on team performance metrics, and address gaps through coaching and changes to regional plans.
  • Partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution.
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard sales talent, and maintain a pipeline of potential future hires in the region.
  • Build an inclusive, positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development.
  • Enable your team on GitLab's product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and industry and regulatory factors relevant to LATAM markets.

What you'll bring

  • Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in open source software, DevOps, or a similar software-as-a-service environment. We welcome transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets.
  • Success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding revenue, pipeline, and other sales performance objectives.
  • Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for LATAM, with a willingness to lead your team and participate directly in selling.

  • Interest in open source and a commitment to GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.

About the team

You'll join our Sales organization in the Commercial LATAM region. As an all-remote team, we collaborate across time zones using asynchronous workflows. We drive new and expansion revenue and partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to serve customers across LATAM.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's largest CPG partners are scaling fast — and the bar for how we show up to them is rising. Our Strategic Sales team works with Fortune 100 brands where a single deal can represent multi-million dollar commitments, and where the relationships we build today determine the category leadership we hold tomorrow. We're hiring a Senior Sales Executive to own some of our most important CPG accounts, driving the kind of consultative, data-backed selling that moves brands from testing Instacart to making it a cornerstone of their annual media plan. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, digital media, and platform monetization — and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to Instacart's top-line growth.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • A portfolio of Fortune 100 CPG accounts has grown revenue meaningfully year-over-year — with annual plans in place, multi-million dollar contracts closed, and executive relationships strong enough to weather tough conversations.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel), Google Drive, and Salesforce; experience with data tools such as Tableau, Periscope, or Mode preferred

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Consistent track record of achieving or exceeding quota while building lasting client relationships

raw.description:
At Aztec, we’re committed to building and nurturing a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to grow. We know that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthen our business and we welcome applications from all individuals. So, if your experience doesn’t exactly match with every part of the job description, but you are excited about the role, we would still like to hear from you. If you are passionate, curious, innovative and data driven, you could still be a good fit.

About the role:

Reports to Head of Enterprise Architecture

At Aztec Group we credit our technology as one of the core ingredients to our award-winning outsourced solutions. We are currently looking for an Enterprise Data Architect to join our architecture team and help Aztec to deliver their exciting new technology strategy, leveraging Databricks.

This role will centre on the design, implementation and maintenance of data models and related architecture for our Azure Data Platform. You will provide technical expertise under the direction of an experienced Manager and with support for continuing professional development, the ideal candidate will become a key part of the Group’s Architecture team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including target-state designs, roadmaps, and architectural standards and patterns.

  • Own the architecture of our Databricks Lakehouse platform, including workspace design, Unity Catalog structure, medallion architecture, and environment strategy.

  • Design and govern integration patterns for sharing data with external clients and third parties, including secure, scalable approaches using Databricks Delta Sharing, APIs, and file-based exchange where appropriate.

  • Lead the design and adoption of Master Data Management (MDM), including entity definitions, golden-record strategy, match-and-merge rules, and stewardship processes.

  • Establish standards and practices for optimising Databricks performance and cost — cluster and compute strategy, Delta table, caching, and workload right-sizing.

  • Define data modelling standards (conceptual, logical, physical) across analytical and operational domains.

  • Work with data governance colleagues to embed data quality, lineage, cataloguing, classification, and access-control policies into platform design.

  • Ensure architectures meet security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and data residency considerations.

  • Review solution designs, provide architectural assurance, and support engineering teams through design authority and peer review.

  • Design data architectures that enable AI adoption — ensuring data is discoverable, well-governed, and AI-ready for machine learning, GenAI, and agentic use cases across the business.

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to define patterns for feature engineering, model data pipelines, vector search, and the safe exposure of enterprise data to AI systems.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and make pragmatic build/buy/adopt recommendations, including data and AI enablement opportunities.

Skills, knowledge and expertise:

  • Deep, hands-on proficiency with Databricks, including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, workflows, and platform administration concepts.

  • Practical experience with Databricks Delta Sharing and designing integration patterns for external data sharing (e.g. Delta Sharing, secure APIs, event streaming, managed file transfer), including the security and contractual considerations involved.

  • Strong track record designing and implementing Master Data Management solutions, including tooling selection, data stewardship models, and reference data management.

  • Demonstrable expertise in Databricks performance and cost optimisation at scale.

  • Strong data modelling skills (dimensional, 3NF, Data Vault or similar) and experience defining enterprise data models.

  • Solid grounding in Azure, including storage, networking, and identity concepts relevant to data platforms.

  • Experience with data governance frameworks and tools (e.g. Microsoft Purview), data quality management, metadata, and lineage tooling.

  • Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python and/or Spark.

  • Understanding of data security and privacy: encryption, access control (RBAC/ABAC), data masking, and regulatory compliance (GDPR).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions in plain language to executive and non-technical audiences.

We will provide the training, both in house for relevant technical knowledge and also professional qualifications to enhance your professional development. You will need to be quick to learn new systems and business processes and great with people, as close working relationships between our colleagues and clients is at the heart of what we do.

We understand that everyone has different needs, and that’s why our employee package includes a variety of benefits. In addition to a competitive salary, here are some examples of the benefits that we may offer for our permanent roles:

  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Flexible, hybrid working
  • Ability to work abroad for up to 3 weeks per annum
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension scheme
  • Private medical insurance, including eye care
  • Life assurance (death in service and critical illness benefit)
  • Worldwide travel insurance
  • Health and wellbeing programmes
  • On-site parking

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Storage Engineer with deep expertise across enterprise storage platforms — NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage, and Ceph — to design, deploy, and operate the storage foundation that supports our compute, virtualization, database, and Kubernetes workloads. The role spans block, file, and object storage across data center, edge, and cloud environments, with strong attention to performance, data protection, and cost. The ideal candidate has operated heterogeneous storage estates at scale, understands the storage characteristics of diverse workloads, and brings strong automation discipline to storage engineering work.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate enterprise storage platforms across NetApp ONTAP, Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade, and Ceph.
  • Implement and manage SAN, NAS, and object storage across data center and cloud environments.
  • Build storage solutions for VMware, Kubernetes (CSI drivers), and database workloads.
  • Design and operate replication, snapshot, and backup strategies for critical data assets.
  • Implement and operate cloud-tiered storage with FabricPool, CloudVolumes, or equivalent.
  • Build storage automation using Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and platform-native automation.
  • Operate Ceph clusters including OSD lifecycle, CRUSH maps, RGW, RBD, and CephFS.
  • Design and operate storage performance management for high-throughput and latency-sensitive workloads.
  • Implement data protection strategies including ransomware protection and immutable snapshots.
  • Build storage observability across capacity, performance, and health dimensions, surfacing the signals operators need to spot capacity pressure, performance regressions, and failing components before users feel the impact.
  • Lead storage upgrades, firmware lifecycle management, and security patching across the storage estate, planning each campaign to maintain availability for the workloads dependent on the platform.
  • Drive storage cost optimization including deduplication, compression, and tiering strategies.
  • Troubleshoot complex storage issues spanning array, network, and host layers.
  • Stay current with storage industry developments and emerging platforms, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of enterprise storage engineering experience.
  • Deep expertise in NetApp ONTAP or Pure Storage FlashArray/FlashBlade.
  • Hands-on experience with Ceph at production scale.
  • Strong understanding of SAN, NAS, and object storage protocols.
  • Experience with storage integration for VMware and Kubernetes (CSI).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Ansible, Terraform, or REST APIs.
  • Strong understanding of storage performance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across storage, network, and host layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Vendor certifications (NCDA, NCIE, Pure Storage certifications).
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud storage replication.
  • Familiarity with software-defined storage platforms beyond Ceph.
  • Experience with object storage at petabyte scale.
  • Exposure to AI/ML workloads with extreme I/O requirements.

A systems engineer that works on the requirements, verifications, certifications, and test team, and supports the creation, and delivery of the data needed by our customer to accept and certify the vehicle prior to delivery. The As-Designed, As-Built report (ADAB) is a part of the acceptance data and certification data packages. This report comes from the program's efforts to perform configuration status accounting (CSA) and ensures that what we delivered to the customer, was what was agreed upon in the design.

As a systems engineer your responsibilities revolve around managing the delivery plans, tracking a variety of metrics, ensuring smooth and constant communication among relevant teams, and understanding the depth of our requirements to ensure that each deliverable is acceptable.

The information below reflects the standard job description for this position: Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or a closely related technical field or equivalent hands on experience
  • Minimum 4 years of full time professional engineering experience in a mechanical or aerospace environment.
  • Experience with process improvements

  • Work with the customer to understand their needs for auditing our data, and reviewing our deliverables
  • Experience coordinating across different teams and worksites

Desired Skills

raw.title: Staff Engineer - DevOps
raw.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
raw.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to help set the technical direction for our internal developer platform at Hard Rock Digital. This is a senior technical leadership role: you’ll help own the long-term architecture and roadmap for our internal developer platform, built on Backstage, and drive its adoption across every team in our organization.

Where our Senior Platform Engineers build the golden paths and self-service capabilities, you’ll define which capabilities matter most, how the platform should evolve, and how we measure success—turning platform engineering from a set of useful tools into a strategic lever for the whole company’s engineering velocity. You’ll work with DevOps, SRE, security, and product engineering teams to build consensus on standards and drive multi-quarter initiatives.

You’ll also set the bar for what AI-enabled engineering looks like at Hard Rock Digital: fluently using AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, and LLM-powered workflows yourself, and championing their adoption—including embedding AI-assisted workflows directly into the platform (e.g. AI-assisted scaffolding, incident triage, or documentation generation via Backstage) so every engineer benefits.

What will you do?

As a Staff DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering, you will:

  • Contribute to the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our internal developer platform (Backstage), including catalog strategy, plugin architecture, and platform APIs.

  • Set company-wide standards for golden paths, self-service workflows, and "paved road" patterns spanning infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD, environments, and observability.

  • Make build-vs-buy and platform-investment decisions, evaluating Backstage plugins, third-party IDP tooling, and custom development against engineering-wide impact and cost.

  • Partner with engineering leadership across product, SRE, security, and data teams to align the platform roadmap with company-wide priorities and identify the highest-leverage investments.

  • Define and report on platform health and developer experience (DevEx) metrics—DORA metrics, self-service adoption rates, lead time to production, ticket deflection—and use them to prioritize the roadmap.

  • Drive adoption of the platform across teams, including migration strategies for legacy infrastructure and workflows onto self-service, Backstage-based patterns.

  • Architect complex, cross-cutting infrastructure and platform capabilities (multi-account AWS, EKS/Kubernetes platform primitives, Terraform/Terragrunt module ecosystems) that other engineers build on top of.

  • Champion security, compliance, and guardrail-by-design practices at the platform level, ensuring self-service capabilities are secure and compliant by default across a regulated, global environment.

  • Champion and scale AI-enabled engineering practices org-wide—evaluating and rolling out AI coding assistants and agentic tooling, embedding AI-assisted workflows into the platform itself, and helping teams adopt AI-enabled ways of working as a default, not an exception.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We’re seeking a seasoned platform engineering leader who has built or scaled an internal developer platform before and understands both the technical depth and the organizational change management required to make self-service actually stick. You should be comfortable operating with significant scope and ambiguity, influencing without direct authority, and translating platform investment into measurable engineering-wide outcomes. Critically, you’re someone who has embraced AI tooling as a genuine force multiplier at both an individual and organizational level—and who can articulate and drive that vision for others.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering, with 3+ years in a senior, staff, or equivalent technical leadership capacity.

  • Demonstrated experience owning the architecture and roadmap for an internal developer platform at scale—Backstage strongly preferred—including catalog design, plugin ecosystems, and platform extensibility patterns.

  • A track record of driving org-wide adoption of self-service workflows and golden paths, including change management across multiple engineering teams.

  • Expert-level knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (multi-account setups, VPC design, IAM policies, networking) at an organizational scale.

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), Docker, and Helm, including designing platform-level abstractions on top of container orchestration.

  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform/Terragrunt, with experience designing module ecosystems consumed by many teams via self-service.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, TypeScript/ for Backstage plugin development) and experience architecting extensible platform tooling.

  • Experience setting CI/CD strategy and standards across an engineering organization, with tools such as GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, TeamCity, or comparable.

  • Strong understanding of observability, DevEx measurement, and how to translate platform investment into metrics leadership cares about (DORA metrics, lead time, adoption rates).

  • Deep knowledge of networking, security hardening, and compliance in regulated industries, with experience embedding these as default, automated guardrails at the platform level.

  • A track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or the broader organization.

  • AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator) strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) and a point of view on how to responsibly scale AI-enabled engineering practices across an organization, including embedding AI-assisted workflows into internal platforms. The ability to operate at, and drive others toward, AI-enabled development velocity is a core expectation of this role, not a nice-to-have.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

You'll create a unified understanding of our customers, markets, competitors, buyer behavior, growth opportunities, and turn that understanding into decisions that shape how Kaseya positions, prices, sells, and wins.

This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to the executive team, real influence over strategy, and the opportunity to build a function — and a team — from a strong foundation.

You'll answer questions that matter: Which customer segments create the highest long-term value? Why do customers buy, expand, renew, or churn? Which competitors represent the biggest threat, and how do we beat them? Where should Kaseya invest next?

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own Kaseya's competitive intelligence program; competitor profiles, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and early-warning systems for competitor product launches, pricing moves, and M&A activity
  • Lead market intelligence: TAM analysis, market landscape assessments, industry trend analysis, and emerging category evaluation across the MSP and SMB IT landscape
  • Build the enterprise Voice of Customer capability, including customer research, buyer journey analysis, and a best-in-class win/loss program
  • Design and maintain Kaseya's customer segmentation framework and ensure all go-to-market teams operate against a common methodology
  • Own the measurement framework for marketing effectiveness - pipeline influence, revenue contribution, campaign performance, and funnel conversion, moving marketing from descriptive reporting toward predictive intelligence
  • Partner with Data Science and Revenue Operations on AI-enabled models for churn prediction, expansion propensity, and customer lifetime value
  • Serve as a trusted intelligence advisor to executive leadership, producing regular Executive Intelligence Reviews on market movements, competitive threats, customer sentiment, and growth opportunities
  • Embed competitive and market insight into sales onboarding, training, and live deal support and measure its impact on win rates
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of analysts and researchers, grounded in curiosity, rigor, and commercial impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, insights, analytics, product marketing, or corporate strategy
  • 3+ years leading intelligence, insights, analytics, research, or strategy teams or programs
  • B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred; experience in IT management, cybersecurity, MSP/channel, or infrastructure software is a plus
  • Demonstrated success building or significantly scaling an intelligence, insights, or analytics function
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, Voice of Customer programs, competitive intelligence, and win/loss analysis
  • Exceptional analytical and synthesis skills; you move from fragmented data to a clear, defensible point of view, and translate analytics into executive decisions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to C-level executives and large sales audiences
  • Strong cross-functional leadership; able to influence without authority across product, sales, marketing, and corporate development

Nice to Have

  • Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth, acquisitive software environments
  • Familiarity with the MSP ecosystem and its competitive landscape
  • Experience with CI platforms (e.g., Klue, Crayon), analyst research (Gartner, Forrester, Canalys), and AI/ML analytics initiatives
  • Experience in subscription and retention-based businesses
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Marketing & AI Innovation

What You Will Be Doing

Brand without performance accountability is positioning. Performance without brand coherence is noise. This role exists at that intersection. You will design and orchestrate omnichannel campaigns across web, email, and social that build brand presence and move measurable business metrics, using agencies and freelancers as execution arms while you own the strategy, the brief, and the outcome. You will also serve as the brand intelligence layer for paid media, feeding creative direction and audience signal to the teams running paid so that owned and paid tell the same story and reinforce each other.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Design omnichannel campaigns with a defined performance thesis: what the campaign is supposed to move, how each channel contributes to that movement, and how the audience journey connects web, email, and social into a single arc rather than parallel activations.
  • Own AEO and SEO strategy as a performance lever, not a hygiene function. Define how the brand wins organic discovery, brief agencies to execute against that architecture, and hold them accountable to rankings, traffic quality, and content performance.
  • Conceive social media campaigns with measurable intent, then direct creative agencies to execute with fidelity to the original strategy. Organic social is the proof of brand voice; you own what it says and what it is trying to do.
  • Own always-on email as the highest-accountability channel in the mix: lifecycle architecture, segmentation logic, automation sequences, deliverability, and performance. This is where brand investment converts to relationship, and you treat it accordingly.
  • Brief web agencies on messaging hierarchy, page intent, and conversion narrative. The brief is your product; the agency executes it.
  • Quantify brand performance: share of voice, earned mentions, amplification rates, sentiment movement, and how those signals correlate with downstream pipeline or revenue metrics. Present brand health as a business argument, not a marketing report.
  • Supply paid media teams with creative strategy, audience insights, and messaging frameworks drawn from owned channel performance, so that paid amplification reflects what is actually working, not what looks good in a deck.

Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years in brand, content, or digital marketing with a clear throughline of performance accountability: roles where you were measured on outcomes, not output.
  • Proven ability to architect campaigns that operate across owned channels simultaneously, with the discipline to define how each channel's job is distinct and how they compound.
  • Strong AEO and SEO strategic fluency, including an understanding of how large language models and answer engines are reshaping organic brand discovery.
  • Agency management experience with evidence that your briefs produced sharp, on-strategy work, not just adequate work.
  • Deep operational ownership of email as a performance channel: you have built lifecycle programs, optimized sequences, and reported on email's contribution to business outcomes.
  • Ability to connect brand metrics to business metrics. You can explain why share of voice moved, what drove it, and what it is worth.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor's in Communication, Journalism, or related Marketing degrees

You Are Not the Right Fit If

  • You think brand and performance are different teams' problems.
  • You measure success by what you produced rather than what it moved.
  • You let agency interpretation substitute for strategic clarity in your briefs.

US - Remote

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web.
Learn more about Pear:

Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data.
Learn more about Keet:

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication.

Requirements

  • Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.

  • Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).

  • Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.

  • Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.

  • Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.

  • Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).

  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.

  • Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.

  • Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).

  • Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the Team

At AudioEye, we believe access to digital content is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is clear: eliminate every barrier to digital accessibility so that everyone, regardless of ability, can experience the web without limitations.

We are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are driven by purpose and impact. Every challenge we tackle moves us closer to a future where creating accessible experiences is the standard. If you’re looking for meaningful work where you can drive real change, influence how people with disabilities experience the internet, and be part of a mission that matters, AudioEye is the place for you.

About the Role

The Account Director drives growth across AudioEye's mid-tier accounts, boosting Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) through upselling, pipeline-building, and collaboration with Customer Success Managers. This quota-carrying role owns quarterly revenue targets via upsells and cross-sells, while ensuring account health and retention.

This role will lead growth conversations and quarterly business reviews, manage an expansion pipeline, and close expansion deals, partnering with the Customer Success team to keep clients positioned for success and provide leadership with clear pipeline visibility.

  • Manage the expansion pipeline across current and upcoming quarters, ensuring accurate forecasting and documentation in HubSpot/Domo as deals progress to closed won
  • Meet weekly with CSMs to review account health, loss risks, and expansion opportunities, aligning on strategy and prioritization together
  • Lead all expansion conversations with customers — discovery, value-sell, solutioning, competitive de-positioning, pricing, and closing — including delivery of recommendations in proposal meetings and QBRs
  • Partner with the Customer Experience Leader on renewal opportunities with a growth component and broader growth strategy
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Service Delivery, and Customer Success to support execution of sold solutions
  • Share insights and best practices with CSMs to strengthen their ability to spot and flag expansion potential
  • Surface feedback and escalate blockers or trends impacting growth across the customer base
  • Stay current on product updates, competitive positioning, and industry trends to effectively position solutions

  • 3+ years of experience in a Mid-market/Enterprise account growth or expansion sales, role within a SaaS or B2B environment
  • Proven track record of identifying, leading, and closing renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities with existing customers (Proven NRR & GRR history)
  • Skilled at working cross-functionally and collaboratively in a team-based account model
  • Strong communicator with the ability to lead strategic conversations and influence decision-makers
  • Confident in managing a pipeline, forecasting accurately, and maintaining CRM hygiene
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to spot trends and surface actionable insights

  • Be Straightforward
  • Act Now & Iterate
  • Grit

  • Hire and Develop A Players
  • Be Coachable

raw.description:
Verisys is looking for a hands-on Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with deep AWS expertise to help build, secure, and scale the infrastructure behind our healthcare credentialing platform. Our environment is primarily Windows-based, and you will be our subject matter expert for Linux, our on-premises Nutanix environment, container platforms (Rancher and Amazon ECS Anywhere), SMTP relay, and SSL/TLS certificates. This is a remote role with high ownership, focused mainly on DevOps and cloud engineering with a meaningful systems administration component. This is a generalist role on a small team: you will move between cloud engineering, systems administration, and whatever the business needs next, so comfort with shifting priorities matters as much as any single skill.
Please note this is a remote opportunity, but you "MUST" live in one of the following states to be considered: AZ, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, MD, MA, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, TN, UT, VA, WI

Duties/Responsibilities:

    Cloud & Containers

    • Design, build, and operate secure, highly available AWS infrastructure (EC2, VPC, IAM, ECS, S3, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager) following the AWS Well-Architected Framework, with an eye on security, cost, and disaster recovery.

    • Manage infrastructure as code (CloudFormation) and support CI/CD pipelines for container builds and deployments.

    • Run containerized workloads on Amazon ECS and ECS Anywhere, and administer Rancher native Cattle clusters.

      • Systems Administration

      • Serve as the Linux subject matter expert: provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, and troubleshooting across physical, virtual, and cloud servers.

      • Administer our Windows Server environment, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and IIS, on-premises and on EC2.

      • Administer our on-premises Nutanix environment using Prism Element and Prism Central, including cluster health, AHV virtual machine management, capacity planning, upgrades, and data protection.

      • Automate configuration and patching with Python, PowerShell, Bash, and AWS Systems Manager.

        • Email, Certificates & Reliability

        • Own our SMTP relay infrastructure (Postfix and/or Amazon SES), including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS, and deliverability troubleshooting.

        • Own SSL/TLS certificate renewals and installation across IIS, Linux web servers, Postfix, and AWS (ACM, load balancers), automating renewals wherever possible.

        • Maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting, participate in on-call, and support HITRUST and SOC 2 compliance.

Required Skills/Abilities:

    • Deep, hands-on AWS experience and strong knowledge of AWS security, networking, and best practices.

    • Expert-level Linux administration and strong Windows Server administration skills.

    • Hands-on experience with Rancher-native Cattle clusters and Amazon ECS / ECS Anywhere.

    • Strong hands-on experience administering Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure, including Prism Element, Prism Central, and AHV.

    • Proficiency with CloudFormation, and PowerShell/Bash scripting; strong Python skills are a major plus.

    • Working knowledge of SMTP relay configuration and end-to-end SSL/TLS certificate management (CSRs, chains, OpenSSL, PEM/PFX).

    • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPN, and security groups.

    • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

    • Adaptable and comfortable wearing many hats, with the ability to shift between cloud, systems, and support work as priorities change.

Education/Experience:

    Required:

    • 5+ years in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and/or systems administration, including 3+ years supporting production workloads in AWS.

    • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

      • Preferred:

      • Strong Python development skills for automation and AWS integrations (e.g., boto3).

      • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer).

      • Red Hat, Linux Foundation, Microsoft, or Nutanix (e.g., NCP-MCI) certification.

      • Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST).

Company Overview:

Verisys transforms provider data, workforce data, and relationship management. More than 400 healthcare, life science, and background screening organizations depend on us to credential providers, improve data quality, publish compliant provider directories, and conduct employment verifications. Our comprehensive solutions deliver accurate and secure information. As a result, we’re the largest outsourced credentials verification organization in the United States. Since we’ve partnered with the most complex institutions in healthcare for decades, we can help organizations of any size discover their true potential.

At Verisys, you can have a rewarding career on every level. In addition to challenging and meaningful work, you will have the chance to give back to your community, make a positive impact on the environment, participate in a range of diversity and inclusion initiatives, and find the support, coaching, and training it takes to advance your career. Our commitment to individual choice lets you customize aspects of your career path, your educational opportunities, and your benefits. And our culture of innovation means your ideas on how to improve our business and our clients will be heard.

Verisys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage all qualified persons of every heritage, nation, gender, veteran, or disability status, age, religion, or other protected status to apply.

Striim, (pronounced “stream” with two i’s for integration and intelligence), is a unified data integration and streaming platform that connects clouds, data, and applications with unprecedented speed and simplicity to deliver the right data at the right time. Striim is used by enterprise companies to monitor events across any environment, build applications that drive digital transformation, and leverage true real-time analytics to provide a superior experience to their customers. At our company, we believe and expect all of our employees to operate as one with unlimited potential and dignity.

Striim is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to serve as the technical leader for strategic technology partnerships across the cloud, data, and AI ecosystem. This role works closely with hyperscalers, database providers, technology partners, and internal cross-functional teams to design, validate, and promote integrated solutions that help customers modernize their data infrastructure with real-time streaming technologies.

The Partner Solutions Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor to partners throughout the relationship lifecycle—from onboarding and technical enablement to solution development, joint go-to-market initiatives, and customer engagements. This individual combines deep technical expertise with strong communication skills to influence partner strategy, accelerate adoption, and strengthen Striim's ecosystem.

As AI becomes increasingly embedded throughout the organization and product portfolio, this role also leverages AI tools to improve technical productivity, accelerate solution development, enhance partner enablement, and identify new opportunities for AI-driven customer solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for strategic cloud, database, and technology partners, building trusted relationships with partner architects and engineering teams.
  • Deliver technical enablement through architecture workshops, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), technical training, and hands-on partner onboarding.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic partner programs, onboarding customers from first introduction to production
  • Design, validate, and document reference architectures that showcase Striim's real-time data streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC), data integration, and AI capabilities across partner platforms.
  • Collaborate with partner sales, engineering, and product teams to support joint customer opportunities and develop repeatable solution playbooks.
  • Design and prototype integrations between Striim and partner technologies, helping expand and strengthen the partner ecosystem.
  • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to communicate partner feedback, influence product direction, and prioritize integration enhancements.
  • Support field Solution Architects and Sales teams during strategic customer engagements involving partner technologies.
  • Develop technical content including architecture guides, best practices, solution briefs, demo environments, and implementation documentation.
  • Represent Striim at partner events, technical conferences, webinars, and customer meetings as a subject matter expert in modern data architectures.
  • Research emerging technologies across cloud, AI, analytics, databases, and streaming platforms to identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering, productivity, and developer tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar technologies) to accelerate solution development, improve documentation, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance partner enablement.
  • Explore and demonstrate AI-driven use cases that combine real-time data streaming with modern AI, machine learning, and agentic AI architectures.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in a Solutions Architect, Partner Engineer, Sales Engineer, Implementation Manager, Customer Engineer, Technical Alliances, or similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience managing customer implementations, constantly revising processes to accelerate customer adoption
  • Experience working with cloud platforms including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures, including real-time data streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC), data integration, ETL/ELT, and event-driven architectures.

raw.description:
We are a a fast-growing global eCommerce company andwe are currently launching a new supplement business with the goal of building multiple supplement brands across different markets and categories.

Our direction is to be the nextThe Vitamin Shoppe— many different supplement categories and products across different brand identities.

We are hiring for an SEO & Product Page Marketing Specialistto join our team!

This is not a traditional “copywriter” role. We are looking for someone who deeply understands:

  • How customers search for supplements online

  • How to structure high-converting supplement product pages

  • How to align ad messaging with landing page messaging

  • How to answer customer objections before they leave the page

  • How to write product pages that convert traffic into buyers

PS: Someone else on the team will handle product photos, labels, renders, and visuals, so you just focus on your expertise 😎

This role is ideal for someone who understands that traffic alone does not make sales. The product page itself needs to match the customer’s intent, build trust quickly, answer objection, educate the customer, increase perceived value, convert cold traffic into paying customers

We are looking for someone who understands the full journey from: Google Search / Ad Click → Product Page → Purchase.

Because this business is being built from the ground up, we are looking for someone who enjoys growing together with a company from an early stage and wants to have real ownership and impact on the visual direction and workflows.

What You’ll Do

Make sure every supplement product page is optimized for:

  • Search intent

  • Conversion

  • Customer psychology

  • Direct-response marketing

  • SEO and keyword alignment

For example:

If we launch a Magnesium supplement and someone clicks on a Google ad searching for:

  • “best magnesium for sleep”

  • “magnesium glycinate benefits”

  • “magnesium for anxiety”

  • “why magnesium before bed”

…you need to ensure the product page immediately answers those questions, handles doubts and objections, builds trust, and converts the customer into a buyer.

We are launching a large amount of supplement SKUs across different brands, so speed, structure, scalability, and understanding consumer intent are extremely important.

  • Write high-converting supplement product pages

  • Research customer search intent and supplement-related keywords

  • Structureproduct pages based on how users arrive on the website

  • Align ad messaging with landing page messaging

  • Write SEO-focused product descriptions and sections

  • Handle customer objections and doubts directly on the product page

  • Create scalable workflows for large amounts of SKUs

  • Collaborate with design and marketing teams

  • Optimize pages for conversion rate and customer trust

  • Research competitors and supplement positioning

  • Help structure product page flows, hooks, angles, and educational content

What We’re Looking For

We’re excited to work with someone who has:

  • Experience with supplement, health, or e-commerce brands

  • Experience with SEO tools, keyword research, Google search intent, and AI - assisted workflows

  • Strong direct-response copywriting and conversion psychology skills

  • Experience writing and optimizing high-converting Shopify product pages or landing pages for conversions

  • Strong understanding of funnels, buyer psychology, customer awareness level, and customer behavior in supplements and e-commerce spaces

We are seeking a board-certified Psychiatrist to serve as a Collaborating Physician for our team of Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs), while also providing part-time direct psychiatric care to clients. This dual role allows for meaningful clinical engagement alongside leadership and oversight responsibilities. Ideal candidates are passionate about team-based mental health care, evidence-based treatment, and supportive collaboration with advanced practice clinicians

Key Responsibilities:

Collaborating Psychiatrist Duties:

  • Provide clinical supervision and support to PMHNPs in accordance with state laws and psychiatric board regulations.

  • Participate in initial and ongoing chart reviews, case consultations, and quality assurance activities.

  • Support PMHNPs in complex psychiatric evaluations, differential diagnosis, and treatment planning as needed.

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and licensing requirements for psychiatric NP supervision.

  • Contribute to ongoing clinical education, best practice implementation, and policy development.

Clinical (Patient-Facing) Duties:

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations and medication management sessions.

  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized treatment plans.

  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric care for a range of mental health conditions (e.g., mood disorders, anxiety disorders, psychotic disorders, ADHD, etc.).

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary team members, including therapists, case managers, and social workers.

  • Maintain up-to-date clinical documentation within the EMR system.

Qualifications:

  • Medical Degree (MD or DO) with residency training in Psychiatry.

  • Board Certification in Psychiatry (ABPN).

  • Active and unrestricted medical license in multiple states, or willing to get licensed in multiple states

  • Minimum of 2 years of post-residency experience, preferably with supervisory or collaborative experience with PMHNPs.

  • Deep understanding of the NP scope of practice in psychiatry and relevant state regulations.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and mentorship skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in outpatient psychiatry and/or telepsychiatry settings.

  • Familiarity with trauma-informed care, integrated care, and/or addiction psychiatry (a plus).

  • Multistate licensure or willingness to obtain additional licenses (if telehealth is part of the model).

  • Experience with EMR systems and virtual collaboration tools.

Title: Short-Form Content Creator

Department: Content

Location: Remote

About CoinPoker

Welcome to CoinPoker, the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker, we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.

The Opportunity

The Short-Form Content Creator is responsible for producing short-form content for CoinPoker's channels end to end, from finding the strongest moments in raw footage through to the final platform-ready edit across Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

The role is focused on scouring streams, tournaments, and partner footage for the hands, reactions, and moments that carry genuine drama, tension, or humour, cutting them into content structured to stop the scroll and hold attention through to the payoff, and maintaining consistent quality at the volume and cadence short-form demands.

The role requires a genuine feel for what makes short-form perform, including hooks, pacing, payoff placement, sound, and captions, and the poker literacy to recognise which moments are worth building content around in the first place.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create short-form content end to end for CoinPoker's channels, from finding the moment in raw footage through selection, cut, hook construction, captions, sound, and platform-native formatting, delivering finished content ready for publishing.

  • Scour streams, tournament footage, and ambassador and partner content on an ongoing basis, identifying the hands, reactions, and moments that carry genuine drama, tension, or humour, and building a bank of usable material for current and future formats.

  • Work to structural briefs on hooks, pacing, and payoff placement, applying feedback from the weekly performance review to each next edit and contributing ideas where a stronger structural approach exists.

  • Produce content across CoinPoker's repeatable formats and series, maintaining the consistency that makes formats recognisable while keeping individual edits fresh.

  • Support campaign and promotional content requirements, including tournament series, product launches, and partner collaboration clips, working to campaign briefs and deadlines alongside ongoing channel output.

  • Maintain consistent output quality at the volume and cadence short-form requires, managing your own edit pipeline and delivering reliably against the content calendar.

  • Use AI and modern editing tools wherever they make output faster or better, without letting the craft slip.

Highly Desired Knowledge and Experience:

  • A portfolio of short-form content you produced that went viral or drove significant reach, ideally in iGaming, poker, or an adjacent space, with the numbers to prove it and the ability to explain what made it work.

  • A real understanding of poker and what makes a moment compelling to a poker audience, including the ability to watch a session and know instinctively which hands, coolers, bluffs, and reactions will land, not just which are technically interesting.

  • Demonstrated ability to source content from raw footage independently, reviewing hours of streams or tournament footage and judging what is worth cutting without being told where to look.

  • Genuine feel for what stops the scroll, including hooks, pacing, payoff placement, sound, and captions, and how each platform's format and audience reward them differently.

  • Demonstrated ability to produce at speed and volume without quality collapsing, including managing your own pipeline against a content calendar.

  • Fluency with modern editing tools and AI tooling where it genuinely improves speed or quality.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the blockchain and online gaming industry.

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work fully remotely.

  • A collaborative and inclusive team culture.

  • Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must‑have insights, market predictions, and best practices for world‑leading organizations.

A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights sector, establishing credibility at local, regional, and global levels. They produce pragmatic and provocative research that clients use to advance key objectives and act as trusted advisors through client interactions, meetings, briefings, and conference engagements.

What you will do:

What you will need:

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural environment

  • Learning agility and ability to navigate matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner’s research methodology effectively

  • Willingness to travel up to 25%

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. The Deal Desk Analyst supports pricing strategy, deal analysis, margin optimization, and commercial decision-making within Optiv's security technology business. This role is heavily focused on pricing analytics, financial modeling, benchmarking, and data-driven recommendations that help improve profitability while supporting revenue growth objectives.

Working closely with Sales, Client Operations Specialists (COS), Finance, and business leadership, the Deal Desk Analyst evaluates complex deal scenarios, identifies pricing and margin opportunities, assesses commercial risk, and develops recommendations that support both customer and company objectives.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in ambiguous situations. They possess strong independent critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move beyond standard analysis, challenge assumptions, connect data points, and develop creative, actionable recommendations. This individual must be capable of using data to tell a story, influence decision-making, and provide practical guidance in a fast-paced, highly dynamic sales environment.

How you'll make an impact

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and COS teams by providing counsel on deal strategy, pricing recommendations, margin optimization, and commercial negotiations for large, complex, and financially sensitive transactions.

  • Analyze sales opportunities to identify risks, pricing pressure, margin improvement opportunities, and alternative solution configurations that optimize commercial outcomes.

  • Develop and leverage pricing models, benchmark analyses, and business insights to support data-driven pricing recommendations.

  • Apply independent judgment and critical thinking to evaluate unique deal scenarios, challenge assumptions, and recommend creative solutions that balance profitability, competitiveness, customer expectations, and long-term account value.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, COS, Finance, Vendor Management, and leadership teams to understand business objectives and develop pricing strategies that support growth and margin goals.

  • Analyze historical transaction data, customer purchasing patterns, vendor pricing, and market benchmarks to identify actionable insights and improve pricing decisions.

  • Support reporting and analysis related to strategic pricing investments, margin exceptions, and approved low-margin opportunities to improve visibility and accountability.

  • Participate in initiatives focused on process improvement, pricing optimization, reporting enhancements, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and collaborate with stakeholders to implement practical, scalable solutions.

What we're looking for

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently evaluate complex business situations and make sound recommendations.

  • Medium to advanced Excel skills, including experience working with large datasets, formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and financial analysis.

  • Experience analyzing dynamic pricing environments or complex commercial scenarios involving competing priorities and unique circumstances.

  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of data into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.

  • Strong business acumen with an understanding of deal economics, customer behavior, competitive dynamics, and the long-term impact of pricing decisions.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively explain recommendations.

  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
