Description

BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust, and ease coexist. Today, 34 of the world's largest 100 banks and 210 total financial institutions rely on BioCatch Connect™ to combat fraud, facilitate digital transformation, and grow customer relationships.. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit .

Position: Technical Account Manager, APAC

Location: Australia, Remote | Travel: Up to 10%

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join our APAC team. In this pivotal role, you will be the primary technical partner for our top-tier enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of our behavioral biometrics fraud prevention platform.

As a trusted advisor, you will own the technical health of your assigned accounts, serve as the escalation point for complex issues, and bridge the gap between customer requirements and our internal product, engineering, and support teams. You will play a vital role in our customers' post-deployment journey, fostering long-term success through technical expertise, proactive optimization, and strategic partnership.

﻿Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Technical Account Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact, building deep, trust-based relationships with customer IT, security, and operational teams.
  • Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on platform performance, architecture, and operational best practices.
  • Advocate for customer needs internally, orchestrating cross-functional efforts with Product, Engineering, and Solutions teams to drive product roadmap and service enhancements.

2. Incident Management & Resolution

  • Own the end-to-end resolution of complex technical escalations and high-impact incidents.
  • Act as the "single-threaded" coordinator during outages or critical issues, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with stakeholders.
  • Drive robust root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventative measures to ensure platform stability.

3. Performance Optimization & Governance

  • Conduct regular technical and operational business reviews to demonstrate platform value and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Proactively monitor environment health, identify potential risks, and execute mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure rigorous adherence to SLAs and operational standards, helping customers maximize the effectiveness of their fraud detection workflows.

4. Integration & Technical Delivery

  • Provide technical leadership for platform upgrades, integration changes, and new feature rollouts.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of technical implementations, from discovery and consultancy through to testing and go-live.

5. Value Enablement & Innovation

  • Educate customer teams on platform capabilities and best practices to drive adoption and long-term ROI.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases and documentation to scale support and self-service capabilities.
  • Leverage data-driven insights and AI-driven automation to enhance customer outcomes and internal operational efficiency.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., TAM, Technical Support Lead, or Solutions Engineer).
  • Technical Proficiency:
  • Deep understanding of enterprise SaaS, distributed systems, and API architectures.
  • Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript or Python) for troubleshooting and automation.
  • Strong analytical skills: ability to parse logs, identify system patterns, and troubleshoot complex technical flows.
  • Familiarity with data platforms (e.g., SQL, Elastic, Snowflake, Tableau, or PowerBI).
  • Knowledge of authentication protocols (Certs, IP whitelisting, Session management).
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex technical concepts for both executive stakeholders and technical peers.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with mobile environments (SDK integration, debugging, app behavior).
  • Experience in the financial services, banking, or fraud prevention sectors.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools or advanced automation frameworks.

Other

  • Ownership & Accountability: A proactive, "can-do" mindset with the drive to resolve issues independently.
  • Strategic Influence: Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Adaptability: A structured, process-oriented thinker who is also a self-directed learner (autodidact).
  • Empathy: High emotional intelligence, capable of balancing deep technical depth with a customer-first approach.
  • Collaboration: A team player who thrives in both independent assignments and cross-functional project environments.

raw.description:
Join our fully remote, mission-driven team dedicated to pioneering sustainable inflight service management. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.

About the role

We are on a mission to contribute to a zero-waste future by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, CO₂ emissions in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision and as a Senior Account Executive, you will be at the heart of the team that makes it possible.

You will report directly to one of the founders and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and the broader founding team.

This is not a traditional SaaS sales role focused on high-volume transactions. Our customers are airlines, our sales cycles are complex, and our relationships often span many years.

You will be responsible for building and executing strategic sales plans, identifying and developing new opportunities, and managing enterprise sales cycles from initial engagement through to contract signature.

Rather than relying solely on inbound demand, you will proactively identify target airlines, build stakeholder relationships, and develop opportunities through a structured account-based sales approach.

We are looking for someone who has already built pipeline, navigated complex airline buying processes, and personally closed significant enterprise business. You will bring both the experience and confidence to independently lead opportunities while collaborating effectively with founders and subject matter experts throughout the sales process.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. While you will mentor and coach junior sales colleagues, your primary responsibility is generating pipeline, advancing opportunities, and winning new business. If your primary motivation is managing teams rather than selling, this role is not going to be a good fit.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Enterprise Sales

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature

  • Develop and execute account-based sales strategies for airline customers

  • Build relationships with executive and senior stakeholders

  • Lead commercial negotiations and enterprise procurement processes

  • Create and maintain strategic account plans

Pipeline Generation & Market Development

  • Identify and pursue new growth opportunities with airlines globally

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities

  • Develop stakeholder maps and engagement strategies

  • Generate opportunities through industry networking, referrals, partnerships, and events

  • Continuously expand LimeFlight's presence within the airline industry

Commercial Leadership

  • Lead by example through active pipeline creation, opportunity management, and enterprise sales execution

  • Mentor and coach junior sales team members

  • Support deal reviews, account planning, and opportunity strategy

  • Share best practices for enterprise sales execution and stakeholder management

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales methodologies and commercial processes

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Founder teams

  • Coordinate internal resources throughout the sales cycle

  • Ensure customer requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally

  • Support smooth transitions from sales into implementation and customer success

  • Act as the voice of the market and customer within LimeFlight

Key competencies

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including significant experience selling to airlines

  • Proven track record of generating pipeline through strategic account-based selling

  • Demonstrated success selling enterprise software, SaaS, or technology solutions to large airline organizations

  • Track record of personally leading and closing enterprise opportunities with a combined contract value exceeding CHF 3 million

  • Experience managing six- and seven-figure enterprise sales opportunities

  • Strong understanding of airline buying processes, stakeholder management, and enterprise procurement

  • Ability to independently drive opportunities forward within complex stakeholder environments

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

  • Strong commercial and business acumen

  • Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude

  • Passion for mentoring and developing others

  • High degree of ownership, accountability, and resilience

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience selling SaaS or enterprise software solutions to airlines.

  • Existing network within the airline industry

  • Deep understanding of airline operations and organizational structures

  • Experience selling across different global markets, with the ability to adapt sales strategies and stakeholder engagement approaches to regional business cultures and buying processes.

  • Experience coaching or mentoring junior commercial team members

Language

  • Fluent English required

  • Additional languages are a plus

Expected travel needs

You should be willing to travel up to 30% of the year for customer meetings, industry conferences, trade shows, and relationship-building activities.

Given the relationship-driven nature of the airline industry, regular face-to-face interactions are an important part of the role.

Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (45 mins)

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager (1 hour)

  3. Technical Interview (1 hour)

  4. Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s)

LimeFlight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.

Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.

Let’s talk!

Highlights

Be part of a mission-driven, remote team committed to sustainable aviation, innovation, continuous learning, and impactful technology shaping a zero-waste future!

Ubique Group is a digital-forward, consumer-driven powerhouse featuring an expansive portfolio of furniture brands. Ubique Group is more than a company; we are a community of passionate, hard-working, and supportive people who believe in our business and each other. We champion the individual capabilities of our employees and the collective power of the team, and extend that commitment to our surrounding families and communities.

We’re hiring a Manager, Talent to help shape how Ubique Group attracts, develops, and mobilizes talent across the organization. This is a strategic and hands-on role for a talent leader who can deliver recruiting results while building scalable programs, workforce insights, and technology-enabled practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead full-cycle recruiting across corporate, distribution, and leadership roles
  • Build proactive sourcing strategies and talent pipelines using CRM technology
  • Strengthen employer branding and recruitment marketing
  • Optimize recruiting workflows, reporting, and candidate experience
  • Identify opportunities to responsibly integrate AI into talent processes
  • Support workforce planning, skills taxonomy, and skills-gap analysis
  • Develop internal mobility and career pathway strategies
  • Lead Ubique Group’s employee referral and internship programs
  • Partner with People & Culture on development and upskilling initiatives

What You’ll Bring

  • Progressive experience in talent acquisition, talent management, or workforce planning
  • Strong full-cycle recruiting and proactive sourcing capabilities
  • Experience with applicant tracking systems, talent CRMs, and recruiting analytics
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical talent strategies
  • Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder partnership skills
  • Interest in AI, workforce technology, skills-based talent practices, and continuous improvement

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package that includes:

Major medical, dental, and vision benefits available day one — no waiting period.

Company-paid life insurance and Employee Assistance Program.

401(k) with company match.

Employee discount on Ubique Group products.

Ubique Group offers 9paid holidays plus 1 floating holiday per year and up to 13 Accrued PTO days per year.

Ochsner empowers you to discover your passion, reach your potential, and Pursue Your Purpose. Exceptional care starts with exceptional people and teams. Together we are leading the way.

This job is primarily responsible for resolving all outstanding insurance account receivables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, performing collection and billing activities related to account resolution, and communicating with payors (Government and Commercial), clients, reimbursement vendors, and other external resources such as patients.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

This job description is a summary of the primary duties and responsibilities of the job and position. It is not intended to be a comprehensive or all-inclusive listing of duties and responsibilities. Contents are subject to change at the company's discretion.

Education

Required – High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred – Associates Degree or Bachelor Degree

Work Experience

Required – 1 year related experience in related hospital, clinic, medical office, business services/revenue cycle, front line registration, financial counseling, banking and/or customer service related job

Preferred – Prior experience working with EPIC system

Knowledge Skills and Abilities (KSAs)

  • Must have computer skills and dexterity required for data entry and retrieval of required job information.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills and the ability to present information clearly and professionally to varying levels of individuals throughout the patient care process.
  • Must be proficient with Windows-style applications, keyboard, and various software packages specific to role.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to multi-task.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast paced ever changing environment.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in high pressure/stressful situations regarding patient financial and medical conversations.
  • Reliable transportation to travel to other facilities to fill in as needed.

Job Duties

  • Performs account research with internal and/or external resources via phone and payor websites to determine status of the account with the expected result of obtaining payment of the account.
  • Verifies and/or updates insurance and demographic information for accuracy to resolve barriers in receiving payment of the account.
  • Follows-up with payors and checks claim status as needed throughout the payment process.
  • Appeal denials when needed throughout the payment process and determines when appeals should be sent for further research and/or review.
  • Maintains knowledge of differing payor guidelines to ensure accurate reimbursement by various resources, such as department meetings and updates on payor websites.
  • Identifies trends that may cause or are causing various types of issues on assigned accounts and reports to leader with recommendations for system improvements/edits.
  • Other related duties as required.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work only. They are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties, and skills. Other duties may be added, or this description amended at any time.

Remains knowledgeable on current federal, state and local laws, accreditation standards or regulatory agency requirements that apply to the assigned area of responsibility and ensures compliance with all such laws, regulations and standards.

This employer maintains and complies with its Compliance & Privacy Program and Standards of Conduct, including the immediate reporting of any known or suspected unethical or questionable behaviors or conduct; patient/employee safety, patient privacy, and/or other compliance-related concerns.

The employer is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Physical and Environmental Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Light Work - Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly (Constantly: activity or condition exists 2/3 or more of the time) to move objects. Physical demand requirements are in excess of those for Sedentary Work. Even though the weight lifted may be only a negligible amount, a job should be rated Light Work: (1) when it requires walking or standing to a significant degree; or (2) when it requires sitting most of the time but entails pushing and/or pulling of arm or leg controls; and/or (3) when the job requires working at a production rate pace entailing the constant pushing and/or pulling of materials even though the weight of those materials is negligible. NOTE: The constant stress and strain of maintaining a production rate pace, especially in an industrial setting, can be and is physically demanding of a worker even though the amount of force exerted is negligible.

Normal routine involves no exposure to blood, body fluid or tissue and as part of their employment, incumbents are not called upon to perform or assist in emergency care or first aid.

The incumbent has no occupational risk for exposure to communicable diseases.

Because the incumbent works within a healthcare setting, there may be occupational risk for exposure to hazardous medications or hazardous waste within the environment through receipt, transport, storage, preparation, dispensing, administration, cleaning and/or disposal of contaminated waste. The risk level of exposure may increase depending on the essential job duties of the role.

raw.excerpt: About TinyMCETinyMCE is the rich text editor behind the content experiences of thousands of software companies and enterprises worldwide.
raw.description:
About TinyMCE

TinyMCE is the rich text editor behind the content experiences of thousands of software companies and enterprises worldwide. It's part of Tiugo Technologies, a portfolio that also includes CKEditor, Uploadcare, and ButterCMS. We're growing into AI-powered content creation, adding AI capabilities on top of the editor that developers already build on.

The Role

You'll be our first dedicated Solutions Engineer. You'll lead the technical side of our most complex deals, mainly TinyMCE AI and strategic enterprise opportunities for the core editor. You'll work each deal alongside our Account Executives, Account Managers, and Product Managers, and you'll set the standard for how we win technically.

This is a player-coach role in practice, even though you won't manage anyone. You'll be involved in deals directly. You'll also build the playbooks, a demo library, and POC framework the rest of the team uses. That work matters as much as the deals. There's no SE leader here to hand you a playbook, because you're writing it.

What You'll Do

Win complex technical deals

  • Lead technical discovery across customer architecture, content workflows, integration requirements, and AI ambitions

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers evaluate architecture choices and challenging assumptions when appropriate

  • Deliver tailored demos rooted in the customer’s use case and needs; not feature tours

  • Own the technical win from discovery through architecture, security review, and sign-off

  • Translate technical capabilities into business outcomes

Run evaluations that lead to decisions

  • Establish clear evaluation criteria and lead disciplined POCs with defined success criteria, outcomes, timelines, and checkpoints

  • Guide build vs. buy and competitive evaluations with a credible view of cost, time to value, and risk

  • Know when a POC isn't the right next step and say so

Make the AI story credible

  • Explain our AI architecture from user experience and orchestration to underlying models to technical and business audiences

  • Navigate topics including LLM APIs, RAG, model choice, data privacy, and security

  • Partner with AEs and AMs to turn technical differentiation into business cases champions can take to economic buyers

Build the SE motion

  • Create reusable demo and discovery frameworks, POC processes, and competitive playbooks

  • Serve as the technical voice of the field to Product and Engineering, bringing structured feedback on customer needs, product gaps, and competitive pressure

  • Enable AEs and AMs to handle first-level technical and AI discovery independently

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in technical pre-sales (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Solutions Architect) at a B2B SaaS company, ideally selling to developers or product teams

  • A consultative, solutions-first mindset. You can map a customer's content workflows end to end, spot where the editor and AI fit (and where they don't), and design a proposed solution. Our products are building blocks, not plug-and-play, and every strategic deal takes some shaping.

  • Experience winning complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise evaluations and running structured POCs

  • Technical fluency with JavaScript, modern front-end frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and integration patterns

  • Working knowledge of modern AI architecture, including LLM APIs, orchestration, RAG, model selection, data privacy, and security

  • Ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business value

  • Strong communication across audiences, from engineers and architects to senior business leaders

  • The judgment and initiative to succeed while establishing our playbook

Role Overview:

As a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager, Edge, at Defense Unicorns, you will lead the product marketing strategy for UDS Fleet and help drive its growth and adoption across defense edge environments. You will report to the Head of Product Marketing and work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, and Executive leadership to strengthen UDS Fleet’s market position and bring new features and capabilities to customers.

This is an execution-heavy role with significant ownership across the product lifecycle. You will define positioning and messaging, develop technical content and demonstrations, enable Growth teams, support feature launches, and help shape how UDS Fleet is packaged, adopted, and communicated. You will also serve as a trusted product expert and evangelist, ensuring our product narratives reflect real mission needs and clearly communicate the value of deploying, managing, and operating software across distributed and edge environments.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive, and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who can operate effectively amid ambiguity, establish structure for a new market offering, and take on new responsibilities as the capability and organization evolve.

  • Develop and execute end-to-end go-to-market strategies for new products and features
  • Define target audiences, positioning, messaging, and product narratives
  • Support product naming, launch planning, adoption, and post-launch optimization
  • Establish the go-to-market foundation for products entering new or undefined markets
  • Establish deep technical expertise across the Defense Unicorns product portfolio

  • Create solution briefs, white papers, technical blogs, and web content
  • Develop presentations, launch materials, videos, demos, and use-case narratives
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to develop repeatable technical demonstrations
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis
  • Translate market intelligence into positioning, messaging, and go-to-market recommendations
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to improve marketing execution
  • Serve as a product evangelist for Defense Unicorns products and philosophies
  • Communicate the value of Defense Unicorns capabilities within the defense industry

  • Operate effectively amid ambiguity and establish structure for new market offerings

Travel Expectation: Approximately 35%–45% travel may be required to engage with customers, communities, partners, and industry stakeholders.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical product marketing, product management, solutions engineering, developer relations, or a related function

raw.description:
Position Overview

Ceresti Health is seeking motivated and compassionate Enrollment Specialists to serve as the first point of connection for family caregivers eligible for Ceresti’s Caregiver Support Program. This role blends outbound caregiver engagement, program education, and enrollment coordination to help families access critical support during some of the most challenging moments of their caregiving journey.

Enrollment Specialists play a vital role in ensuring caregivers understand the program, feel supported in their decision, and are successfully enrolled to begin receiving services. This is not a traditional sales role — it is a mission-driven enrollment role grounded in empathy, clarity, and follow-through, with clear performance expectations.

Quantitative Performance Expectations

Enrollment Specialists are measured on objective, clearly defined metrics, including:

  • Outbound call volume and caregiver contact rate
  • Enrollment agreements (“Agrees”) and completed enrollments
  • Conversion rates from contact to enrollment
  • Documentation accuracy and CRM hygiene
  • Timeliness of follow-up and handoffs to downstream teams

Success requires balancing productivity, quality conversations, and caregiver experience.

Why This Role Matters

For many families, the Enrollment Specialist is their first human interaction with Ceresti. Caregivers often reach us feeling overwhelmed, unsure, or skeptical. The way enrollment conversations are handled directly impacts caregiver trust, program engagement, and long-term outcomes.

Enrollment Specialists are not just enrolling participants — they are opening the door to support, education, and relief for families navigating dementia care.

Key Responsibilities

Caregiver Outreach & Engagement

  • Initiate outbound calls to eligible family caregivers to introduce Ceresti’s Caregiver Support Program.
  • Conduct thoughtful, respectful conversations that assess caregiver needs and readiness.
  • Clearly explain the program’s purpose, benefits, and expectations in caregiver-friendly language.
  • Balance empathy with confidence to guide caregivers toward informed enrollment decisions.

Enrollment & Workflow Management

  • Secure caregiver agreement to enroll and guide them through next steps.
  • Accurately document all interactions, outcomes, and notes in Ceresti’s CRM and enrollment systems.
  • Manage assigned leads and follow-up queues to ensure timely outreach and resolution.
  • Coordinate handoffs to coaches, operations, or support teams as needed.

Quality, Compliance & Collaboration

  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and internal privacy standards.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, and performance reviews.
  • Share insights from caregiver conversations to improve scripts, workflows, and enrollment strategies.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to caregiver experience and enrollment efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in English.
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
  • Comfort conducting frequent phone-based conversations.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in enrollment, inside sales, outreach, or customer engagement roles.
  • Familiarity with caregiving, healthcare, or dementia-related challenges (professional or personal).
  • Experience using CRM systems to log calls, notes, and outcomes.
  • Ability to adapt messaging based on caregiver emotional state and readiness.
  • Experience working in HIPAA-compliant or regulated environments.
  • Comfort learning and navigating new technology platforms (Mac/iOS preferred).

Skills & Attributes

  • Empathetic, patient, and emotionally intelligent.
  • Confident, clear communicator who can build trust quickly.
  • Results-oriented while maintaining caregiver dignity and respect.
  • Organized, reliable, and consistent with follow-up.
  • Resilient and able to handle rejection without losing compassion.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive hourly rate with performance-based incentives
  • Location: Remote (ability to support caregivers across multiple time zones preferred)
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday (some flexibility and weekend availability may be required during high-volume periods)

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Mission-driven, collaborative team culture
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Opportunity to grow into senior enrollment, training, or operational roles

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Analytics Engineering, you'll lead a team of 8 and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You set direction across the data organization, stay close enough to the work to guide technical decisions credibly, and partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, IT, and business leaders.

You will have three mandates:

  1. Build trusted, AI-ready self-service. Deliver a semantic model that answers business questions correctly, with the telemetry, evals, and model flexibility to prove it and keep costs in check.
  2. Set the strategy for how GitLab accesses data. Own the data models, BI tools, and AI access patterns (Claude, MCP servers, Slack agents) that put trusted data in everyone's hands.
  3. Build data applications the whole company relies on. Ship production-grade apps that combine trusted data, APIs, and AI to answer questions dashboards can't.

What you'll do

  • Build and own a trusted semantic model, with governed metrics and business definitions, that answers business questions consistently across every tool
  • Build evals and ground-truth datasets that measure answer quality, and use them to drive improvements and catch regressions
  • Instrument telemetry to see who uses the semantic model and AI tools, what they ask, and where they get stuck
  • Build a model-selection harness so GitLab can route work across LLMs and stay flexible on cost and quality
  • Own data modeling and curated datasets for self-service, with the ownership, data contracts, testing, and documentation that make them AI-ready
  • Define the AI data access strategy: when to use BI, Claude, MCP servers, or Slack agents, with the governance and security to keep access trusted and reliable
  • Own the enterprise BI and self-service tools strategy (e.g., Tableau, Omni), including evaluation, adoption, and cost
  • Build self-service capabilities, such as Claude skills, documentation, and guided workflows, that help people find and use data on their own
  • Build and own company-wide data applications, from Claude-built single-page apps to apps inside BI tools, that combine Snowflake data, API calls, AI-powered deep dives, and write-back to Postgres or Snowflake
  • Set engineering standards for data apps (security, authentication, testing, deployment, and monitoring) so they're reliable at company scale
  • Set a long-range roadmap tied to company strategy, and a lightweight operating model that balances urgent stakeholder needs with investment in reusable data products and tech-debt reduction
  • Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of 8: build career paths, develop leaders, distribute ownership, and recognize great work
  • Act as customer zero for GitLab and GitLab Duo in data workflows, sharing feedback with Product and Engineering

What you'll bring

  • 12+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, including 5+ years leading teams and 2+ years managing managers or senior leads
  • Deep expertise in data modeling and semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, LookML, Cube), and expert dbt, including testing and CI/CD across a multi-team project
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered data access (text-to-SQL, agents, MCP servers), including evals and telemetry for answer quality, and advanced use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code
  • Expert SQL and strong Snowflake experience; working knowledge of Python
  • Strong data governance experience: data quality, lineage, certified datasets, and access controls (RBAC, row access and masking policies)
  • Track record of leading cross-functional data initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable business impact, including enterprise BI and self-service at scale
  • Systems thinker who sees how models, pipelines, and architecture decisions connect, and designs for second-order effects
  • Exceptional communicator who writes clear technical specs, sets a clear vision, makes trade-offs visible, and influences executives and peers across the company
  • Pragmatic in ambiguity: makes sound decisions on emerging technology and ships the right next version rather than waiting for the ideal end state
  • Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLM routing or gateway tools and managing model costs
  • Experience with Tableau, Omni, or a BI platform migration
  • Experience with web app development (e.g., React, TypeScript) and Postgres
  • Experience owning finance or revenue-critical data (e.g., ARR, consumption) where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable

About the Team

Analytics Engineering makes GitLab's data trusted, easy to find, and ready for anyone to use, whether they ask a dashboard, Claude, or a Slack agent. We own the curated data models, the semantic layer, the self-service tools, and the data applications that let teams answer their own questions.

AI is changing how people get to data. Questions that once went through an analyst now go straight to AI tools, so the answers are only as good as the data models and business definitions behind them. Our job is to make those answers correct, consistent, and measurable.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Molina Healthcare of California is hiring a Transition of Care Coach LVN/LPN. This role is remote; however, candidates must have a valid and unrestricted California LVN/LPN licensure. The hours will be Monday through Friday from 8am to 5pm Pacific Standard Time.

Highly Qualified Candidates Will Have the Following-

  • Must be an LVN/LPN with an active, unrestricted California licensure
  • Monday through Friday from 8am to 5pm Pacific Standard Time
  • Solid and above average computer skills. Able to navigate MS Outlook/Excel/Word and learn Windows based software. Point Click Care, Epic, etc…
  • Managed care experience.
  • Medi-Cal and Medicare knowledge.
  • Experience with care coordination and discharge planning.
  • Familiarity with community-based organizations and social service resources.
  • Knowledge of social determinants of health.
  • Bilingual skills (desired, not required) (Spanish, Vietnamese, Mandarin, or other prevalent languages preferred).
  • Experience working with high-risk or vulnerable populations.

Essential Job Duties

  • Provides support for care transition activities. Facilitates transitional care processes and coordination for member discharge from hospital admission to all other settings. Strives to ensure that best possible services are available to members at time of hospital discharge and focuses on goal to reduce member readmissions. Contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.
  • Follows member throughout a 30 day program that starts at hospital admission and continues oversight through transitions from acute setting to all other settings, including nursing facility placement/private home, with the goal of reduced readmissions.
  • Ensures safe and appropriate transitions by collaborating with the hospital discharge planner, as well as collaborating with hospitalists, outpatient providers, facility staff, and family/support network.
  • Ensures member transitions to setting with adequate caregiving and functional support, as well as medical and medication oversight support.
  • Works with participating ancillary providers, public agencies or other service providers to make sure necessary services and equipment are in place for safe transition.
  • Conducts face-to-face visits of all members while in the hospital and, home visits high-risk members post-discharge as needed.
  • Coordinates care and reassesses member needs using the Coleman Care Transition model post-discharge.
  • Educates and supports member focusing on seven primary areas (Transition of Care Pillars): medication management, use of personal health record, follow-up care, signs and symptoms of worsening condition, nutrition, functional needs and or home and community-based services, and advance directives.
  • Uses motivational interviewing and Molina clinical guideposts to educate, support and motivate change during member contacts.
  • Assesses for barriers to care, provides care coordination and assistance to member to address concerns.
  • Facilitates interdisciplinary care team meetings (ICT) and collaboration.
  • Transition of care coaches with behavioral health and social science education may provide consultation, resources and recommendations to peers as needed.
  • 40-50% local travel may be required (based upon state/contractual requirements).

  • At least 2 years experience in health care, with at least 1 year of experience in hospital discharge planning, care management or behavioral health setting, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN). Clinical licensure and/or certification required ONLY if required by state contract, regulation, business operating model, or state board licensing mandates. If licensed, license must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.
  • Valid and unrestricted driver's license, reliable transportation, and adequate auto insurance for job related travel requirements, unless otherwise required by law.
  • Knowledge of or experience using the Care Transitions Intervention (CTI) or similar model.
  • Background in discharge planning and/or home health.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of community resources.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented.
  • Ability to work within a variety of settings and adjust style as needed - working with diverse populations, various personalities and personal situations.
  • Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision and demonstrate self-motivation.
  • Responsive in all forms of communication, and ability to remain calm in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to develop and maintain professional relationships.
  • Excellent time-management and prioritization skills, and ability to focus on multiple projects simultaneously and adapt to change.
  • Excellent problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office suite/other applicable software program(s) proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Transitions of care sub-specialty certification and/or Certified Case Manager (CCM).
  • Hospital discharge planning or home health experience.

Mission Support Engineer – Networking

Location: Remote, with mission-driven travel. Travel volume varies considerably by season and program; we’re happy to discuss specifics with candidates.

Job Type: Full-Time

About Somewear Labs

Somewear Labs builds communication and unmanned systems technology for mission-critical operations in challenging environments.

Job Summary

The Mission Support Engineer – Networking is a hands-on, forward-deployed technical expert who owns the success of our communications and networking deployments — from pre-mission preparation through execution and recovery. You will translate mission requirements into working network architectures, diagnose problems in austere conditions, and enable operators to use the capability confidently on their own.

Key Responsibilities

Mission Support & Field Execution

  • Own technical execution of communications and networking deployments, including trials, evaluations, demonstrations, exercises, and operational missions.

  • Serve as the on-site technical owner for network readiness, configuration, troubleshooting, and mission performance.

  • Conduct pre-mission checks, equipment preparation, configuration, and readiness assessments; support post-mission recovery, documentation, and after-action review.

  • Translate mission requirements into practical connectivity and network architecture.

  • Drive issues to resolution in the field using structured troubleshooting and sound engineering judgment rather than escalation.

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot mission networking and communications equipment.

  • Troubleshoot IP addressing and subnetting, routing, NAT, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, tunnels, encrypted overlays, and firewall and traffic filtering rules.

  • Diagnose MTU, latency, packet loss, and constrained-bandwidth problems, and capture and analyze traffic using tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark.

  • Deploy and troubleshoot video streaming over constrained and contested links, including RTSP, RTP/UDP, SRT, MPEG-TS, WebRTC, and HLS; H.264/H.265 encoding; and ONVIF-compliant cameras and encoders.

  • Tune video streams for available bandwidth and latency budgets — bitrate, resolution, GOP and keyframe interval, buffering, multicast versus unicast — and resolve firewall, NAT traversal, and transcoding issues affecting feeds to ATAK, ground control stations, and downstream consumers.

  • Work with RF communications and satellite or other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity as the mission requires.

Linux, Software & Automation

  • Administer and troubleshoot Linux from the command line: processes and services, logs, network interfaces, routing tables, firewall rules, permissions, packages and dependencies, and system resource utilization.

  • Work with APIs, configuration files, logs, and command-line tools to configure systems and diagnose mission issues.

  • Build temporary diagnostic tools, scripts, or workarounds when needed to isolate a problem or keep a mission moving.

Customer Enablement & Product Feedback

  • Train operators on network setup, communications workflows, and troubleshooting, and support onboarding into operational use.

  • Advise customers on incorporating the technology into SOPs, CONOPs, and training pipelines, and deliver technical briefs and demonstrations covering capabilities and limitations.

  • Synthesize operator feedback and field observations for Product and Engineering, and help validate new capabilities and integrations prior to launch.

Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on, engineering-level experience diagnosing and resolving networking and communications problems in field, tactical, or other mission-critical environments.

  • Strong practical networking knowledge across the areas described above, including packet capture and analysis.

  • Working experience with video streaming protocols and codecs (RTSP, RTP/UDP, SRT, MPEG-TS, WebRTC, HLS; H.264/H.265) and with troubleshooting video delivery over bandwidth-constrained links.

  • Proficiency administering and troubleshooting Linux systems from the command line.

  • Working knowledge of RF communications and at least one beyond-line-of-sight, satellite, or tactical communications environment.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures.

  • Experience briefing, training, or supporting military, government, or defense customers.

  • Strong problem-solving, field judgment, and communication skills.

  • Ability to travel a minimum of 25%.

  • Relevant field, military, technical, or operational experience may substitute for an engineering degree.

Preferred

  • Prior Mission Operations, Field Operations, Program Support, Field Service, Network Operations, or Technical Pre-Sales experience.

  • Experience supporting large-scale government evaluations, operational tests, field exercises, or deployed communications missions.

  • Experience with satellite communications, tactical or mesh networking, or RF systems in austere environments.

  • Familiarity with Somewear Labs' platforms or similar technologies.

Event Manager, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Event Coordinator, Event Project Manager, Event Operations Manager, Project Manager

Could you deliver a flawless day for hundreds of students in a city you have never set foot in?

On a typical day you might walk a venue coordinator in Melbourne through your room and AV requirements in the morning, lock catering numbers against the live registration count and follow up two presenter confirmations with the academic team after lunch, and update the run sheet and brief the on-ground leads before you log off.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture, and this role sits with the events function that delivers Contour's event calendar across Australia.

A great event looks effortless to the family walking in. Someone has to be the reason it looks that way.

About This Role

You are the dedicated project manager behind Contour's events. The calendar runs from full exam simulation days for hundreds of students to revision lecture series selling thousands of tickets across Victoria and Queensland, with parent workshops and online sessions in between. You take each one from first brief to post-event review: timeline, venue, suppliers, registration milestones, comms deadlines, run sheet, event-day coordination, wrap-up.

You report to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). The CMO owns marketing strategy and the onshore event-day call when someone must be in the room. Everything else about how events get planned and delivered is yours. Marketing owns promotion, creative, and the registration campaigns. Academics owns session content and who presents it. Operations owns student data and check-in technology. On event day, teams on the ground in Australia execute in the room. The plan that ties them together, the dates they all work to, and the accountability for the day landing well: those are yours.

Two qualities separate a strong hire from an average one here. First, you think in dependencies: you see that catering numbers hang off registration close, which hangs off a reminder email, which hangs off a presenter confirming a title, and you fix the weak link three weeks early instead of discovering it three days out. Second, you follow up without souring relationships: you ask specifically, escalate when twice was enough, and people still enjoy working with you.

One more reality worth naming: you will rarely be in the room. You run events from India that are delivered in Australia, which means your plans, run sheets, and briefings have to be strong enough that the day runs without you standing in it.

You start as the sole dedicated event project manager, plugged into established marketing, academic, operations, and student experience teams. The calendar has grown faster than the way it is run: the biggest series now sell out lecture theatres, and until now no single person has owned how events get delivered. You build that playbook: the standard project plan, the run sheet format, the review loop that makes each event sharper than the last.

By the end of month three, you will have taken at least one major event from brief through delivery to review, built the project plan and run sheet templates the team reuses, and mapped the full calendar with owners, dates, and dependencies visible to everyone involved. What you build in those months will run every event Contour delivers after them.

Where the Work Lives

  • monday.com: project plans and task ownership live here. Keeping status current is how a remote team knows an event is on track without asking.

  • Google Sheets: run sheets, attendee lists, and event-day logistics. The people delivering the day work from your latest version, so document discipline is part of the job.

  • Eventbrite: registrations and ticketing. You watch the numbers daily because rooms, catering, and comms decisions all key off them.

  • HubSpot: student and guardian event comms run through it, alongside the lifecycle comms team.

  • Slack: where cross-team, cross-timezone coordination happens, in writing.

What You Will Do

  • Own each event end to end.Scope, timeline, suppliers, delivery, invoices, review: nothing about the event is someone else's problem.

  • Build and drive the project plan.Every task with an owner, a date, and a dependency in monday.com. When something slips, you catch it while there is still room to re-sequence.

  • Keep the full event calendar visible.Every event, owner, and key date in one place in monday.com, so anyone can see what's coming without asking you.

  • Coordinate Marketing, Academics, and Operations.Registration launches, presenter confirmations, resource handovers, comms milestones: you set the dates and hold every team to them.

  • Lock venues and suppliers.Room requirements, AV, catering, printing, signage: briefed clearly, confirmed in writing, and settled before their cutoffs.

  • Run registrations as a control signal.Work with the digital team on ticket setup in Eventbrite, track numbers daily, and trigger capacity, waitlist, and extra-session calls in good time, because 850 registrations against 760 seats is a problem you want weeks of notice on, not days.

  • Write the run sheet and brief the day.Minute by minute, with named owners for every stage, and briefings that leave the teams in the room certain of their part.

  • Close the loop.Attendance data, feedback, supplier invoices, a short post-event report, and fixes carried into the next plan.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 4 to 6 years delivering projects or events where you held the whole timeline, not a slice of it

  • You have delivered work that depended on people who did not report to you, and it landed anyway

  • Comfortable chasing and escalating. A quiet slip three weeks out becomes an event-day crisis, so persistence here is method, not personality, and the people you chase still want to work with you again.

  • Writing that lands exactly as intended. Your documents are how a remote coordinator directs a live day, so they carry more weight than they would in an office

  • Clean document and data habits: plans, lists, and versions other people can trust without checking with you

  • Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference, with the flexibility to be on deck when events go live

Nice to Have

  • You have run an event remotely, delivered in a city or country you were not in

  • Events for education, exams, or student and family audiences

  • Hands-on with monday.com, Eventbrite, or HubSpot

  • Negotiating with venues and suppliers

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What Good Looks Like

  • Nothing slips silently:every at-risk date is flagged with a re-plan attached, not just an apology.

  • The day runs off the document:venue and floor teams execute from your run sheet without needing you on the phone every ten minutes.

  • Stakeholders answer you:your asks are specific, dated, and easy to action, so people respond instead of stalling.

  • Every event beats the last:reviews turn into changes in the next plan, not a document nobody opens.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. The events themselves happen in Australia; you coordinate them from wherever you are, and onshore teams deliver on the day. Compensation details shared early in the hiring process. After you apply: a short screen, a practical planning task, then a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Chief Marketing Officer, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on the most complex event or project you have delivered, and the moment it nearly went wrong.

ABOUT US

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Calibrate, our clinical team of doctors, nurse practitioners and nurses are at the heart of our mission to change the way the world treats weight by offering comprehensive obesity care that results in life-changing, sustainable results. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in delivering evidence-based, patient-centered care that integrates coaching and curriculum for lifestyle support.

We’re looking for physicians who are passionate about improving lives through a holistic approach to weight health. You'll collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, contribute to an innovative care model, and help patients achieve meaningful, lasting results.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and help shape the future of obesity medicine through telehealth. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact in the lives of patients while working in a supportive environment as a seasonal physician working a minimum of 10 hours per week January 2027 through April 2027.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Consistently provide a world-class level of clinical care and patient experience
  • Perform telehealth virtual visits with patients, including the discussion of the scientific principles of obesity and the prescription of appropriate weight loss therapy based on Calibrate clinical protocols
  • Utilize and support a detailed clinical treatment paradigm, developed and updated by the Calibrate team and specialized to support obese patients achieve weight-loss goals
  • Able to work a consistent minimum of 10 hours per week (up to 40 hours per week) in a remote telehealth setting (Monday through Friday)

BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE

  • BC/BE MD - family medicine, internal medicine (with or without subspecialization), or emergency med with primary care experience; other BC/BE physicians with specific obesity medicine experience are also welcome to apply
  • Demonstrated excellent written/verbal communication skills and virtual “bedside” manner
  • Active, unrestricted license in AL, AR, FL, GA, KY, LA, MS, MO, SC, TN [MUST be licensed in FL or TN]

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Integrated Care Wins.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

We continuously learn from outcomes, data, and our experience to refine our care model and raise the standard of obesity treatment.

Great Partners.

We strive to be easy to work with and trusted by patients, employers, clinicians, partners, and our fellow Calibraters.

Calibrate is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. To achieve our mission of changing the way the world treats weight, we are building an environment where every Calibrater can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do the best work of their careers. We value diversity and recruit, hire, and promote individuals solely based on talent, qualifications, competence, and merit. We evaluate candidates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics as required by law and as a matter of our company values.

The Advanced Supplier Quality Engineer IV is responsible for ensuring supplier materials, processes, and finished products meet company quality standards. This role performs advanced inspections, audits, root cause identification, corrective action review and acceptance, and data analysis while driving supplier performance improvements and long-term quality excellence.

Please note: This position will involve working with technical data, technology, software/source code, hardware, or other items (collectively “items) subject to U.S. and non-U.S. export control laws and regulations. Under these regulations, it may be necessary for TE to verify a candidate’s national origin and/or citizenship status to determine whether a U.S. or other government export license is required prior to releasing its technologies to the candidate.   • Analyze quality data and performance trends to identify risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities

  • Partner with suppliers to improve performance through coaching, mentoring, assessments, inspections, auditing, and training initiatives
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues and implement preventive controls
  • Ability to Travel >60%

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality, or related field

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

raw.description:
OptionMetrics, headquartered in New York, NY. is a dynamic and innovative technology company, a trusted provider of financial information and research derived from the option markets. We are at the forefront of developing solutions that empower businesses. Our commitment to excellence, coupled with a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, has made us the preferred choice for top-tier talent. Our data and analytics models are utilized by over 350 investment banks, hedge funds, asset management firms, and academic institutions globally, solidifying our position as a leader in the industry.

Are you ready to own the cloud foundation behind a market-leading financial data business? At OptionMetrics, we're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer to own our multi-account AWS environment, our client-facing file-delivery platform, the deployment pipelines and scheduled workflows that ship our data, and the security controls around all of it. Our clients and internal teams depend on this infrastructure every day. You'll keep it reliable, automate how it runs, and leave it better documented than you found it.

You'll report to the Head of IT Operations and work closely with Engineering, Product, Sales and Customer Support.

What You'll Own:

    Client file delivery (CrushFTP): Production, test and DMZ environments on autoscaling and S3, client and support account provisioning, and operating the legacy platform through its retirement.

    AWS multi-account foundation: Organizations, SSO and IAM, the Transit Gateway hub-and-spoke network, and the migration of workloads off the main account.

    TLS and certificates: A full certificate inventory, auto-renewing ACM certificates, and alerting on expiring or mismatched certificates across every domain.

    Edge and application security: Cloudflare and AWS WAF rules, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and incident response for customer-facing applications.

    DevOps and release engineering: CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TeamCity), deployments to production and non-production environments, and release plans for every production change.

    Workflow automation and monitoring: Our scheduled data workflows (Stonebranch/OpsWise), plus monitoring, alerting and on-call (Site24x7, Opsgenie) for business-critical jobs and services.

    Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and GitHub Actions with OIDC-based deployment, a sandbox account, and code-reviewed changes.

    Cost and compliance: Cost reporting, tag enforcement with AWS Config, and CrowdStrike coverage and access audits.

What You'll Do:

    Design, build and operate highly available AWS infrastructure across dev, test, prod and DMZ accounts.

    Plan and run production changes with a published change notice covering scope, impact, rollback and confirmation.

    Perform and oversee deployments to production and non-production environments, with a release plan, a rollback path and a Jira record for each.

    Build, maintain and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, and help development teams ship safely and repeatably.

    Monitor and tune business-critical scheduled workflows, troubleshoot failures, and drive failed jobs to root cause through the weekly failure review.

    Build monitoring, alerting, consolidated metrics and logs that give stakeholders a clear view of system and workflow health.

    Respond to infrastructure and security incidents: contain first, then find the root cause and document it in Jira.

    Turn repeated manual work into automation using scripts, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code and AI tooling.

    Apply least privilege to every access request: expiring SSO roles, and no long-lived keys without a documented use case.

    Write and maintain runbooks, architecture and network diagrams, and Confluence standards for everything you own, including legacy systems.

    Keep Jira current: every ticket you own shows a status, a blocker or a next step, updated at least every two weeks.

    Take ad-hoc requests from Sales, Support and Product. Clarify the need, commit to a date, and deliver.

    Coach junior engineers and hand off repeatable work to them with written runbooks.

How We Work:

    Disagree, then commit. Push back with evidence. Once a decision is made, deliver it as agreed, or agree an alternative in writing.

    Respect for colleagues. Criticize the problem, not the people or teams involved, in every channel.

    Stay calm when escalated. Answer with status and next steps.

    Make your work visible. Post a daily written standup update (Shipped / Next / Blockers) and take part in team rituals.

    Review every change. Production changes go through code review, including urgent ones.

    Own the whole job. Documentation, legacy systems and request handling are part of the role, not a distraction from it.

Skills You'll Need:

    6+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, including 4+ years running production AWS.

    Deep AWS experience: VPC, Transit Gateway, Client VPN, IAM, SSO, Organizations, ELB/ALB/NLB, ACM, EC2 Auto Scaling, S3, AWS Config and CloudTrail.

    Strong Linux administration skills.

    Hands-on DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, release management, and supporting development teams through deployments.

    Experience running a job scheduler or workflow automation platform (Stonebranch/OpsWise, Control-M, Airflow or similar) and troubleshooting failed pipelines.

    Production experience with Terraform and CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including OIDC.

    Solid grounding in TLS/PKI, DNS (Route53 and external providers) and file transfer over FTP, FTPS, SFTP, SSH and HTTP/HTTPS.

    A security mindset: least privilege, WAF and rate limiting, and incident response.

    Scripting in Python or Bash.

    Clear written and verbal communication: change notices, runbooks and Jira write-ups others can act on.

    A track record of delivering on commitments in an environment with frequent interruptions.

Skills You'll Need:

    6+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, including 4+ years running production AWS.

    Deep AWS experience: VPC, Transit Gateway, Client VPN, IAM, SSO, Organizations, ELB/ALB/NLB, ACM, EC2 Auto Scaling, S3, AWS Config and CloudTrail.

    Strong Linux administration skills.

    Production experience with Terraform and CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including OIDC.

    Scripting in Python or Bash.

    Clear written and verbal communication: change notices, runbooks and Jira write-ups others can act on.

    A track record of delivering on commitments in an environment with frequent interruptions.

What Will Make You Stand Out:

    AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, SysOps or Security).

    SRE or platform engineering experience, including SLOs, observability and on-call practice.

    Experience with TeamCity, Site24x7 or Opsgenie.

    Containers and orchestration (Docker, ECS).

    Experience with CrushFTP or other managed file-transfer platforms.

    Cloudflare experience (WAF, Turnstile, access rules).

    Building AI tooling for operations, such as Claude skills or agents for runbooks and audits.

    Experience with CrowdStrike and Active Directory.

    Leading a multi-account AWS migration from start to finish.

    Experience in financial data or fintech.

What Success Looks Like:

    First 90 days: Every certificate is on auto-renewal or alerting. The AWS network diagram for all accounts is published. Runbooks exist for account provisioning and read-only access requests. No ticket you own goes more than 14 days without an update.

    First year: Every production deployment follows a documented release plan, and scheduled workflow failures are trending down month over month. Workloads are off the main account. All new infrastructure is in Terraform with code review. Tag compliance is above 95%. Legacy CrushFTP is retired. Junior engineers handle routine requests from your runbooks.

What We Offer:

    A collaborative environment where everyone's input makes a difference.

    Paid time off: Vacation, Personal, Sick days, and Holidays.

    Pre-tax commuter benefits (NJT, MTA, etc.) and 401k plan offered.

    Full medical and dental insurance coverage.
